display_long_description: METWIN is a mixed reality (MR) learning and training module for Meta Quest that blends your physical environment with interactive virtual content — so you learn by doing, right in your own space.   Using hand tracking, gesture interaction, and spatial awareness, METWIN anchors 3D digital objects into the room around you. Reach out, grab, rotate, and operate them with your bare hands — no controllers required. Passthrough keeps you aware of the real world while virtual parts, machines, and guides appear exactly where you need them. WHO IT’S FOR Trainees learning a new procedure, industrial and frontline teams rehearsing tasks safely, and anyone who learns faster by interacting than by watching.  WHAT YOU CAN DO  • Practise procedures hands-on with spatially anchored 3D objects • Interact through natural hand tracking and gestures  • Blend real and virtual with Quest mixed reality passthrough • Rehearse complex or high-risk tasks in a safe, repeatable space • Learn at your own pace, step by step  WHY METWIN  Reading a manual is passive. METWIN is experiential — spatial, hands-on, and intuitive — so skills transfer to the real task. It brings digital-twin-style interaction and industrial training simulation into one accessible MR module.  Put on your headset, look around your space, and start training with your hands. Mixed reality learning you can reach out and touch
